description: This file contains unit tests for the AcknowledgementAggregatorActor class, which manages acknowledgements for delete commands in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It uses Akka testkit to simulate actor behavior and tests various acknowledgment scenarios.

classes.name: AcknowledgementAggregatorActorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the AcknowledgementAggregatorActor, validating acknowledgment handling, error responses, header management, and reset logic within the Ditto framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the actor system and header translator before each test.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Shuts down the actor system after each test.

methods.name: returnSingleResponseForTwin
methods.description: Tests that a single acknowledgment response for a 'twin' acknowledgment label is returned correctly.

methods.name: returnSingleResponseForLive
methods.description: Tests that a single acknowledgment response for a 'live' channel is returned correctly.

methods.name: returnErrorResponseForTwin
methods.description: Tests that a timeout results in a GatewayCommandTimeoutException wrapped in a ThingErrorResponse for 'twin' label acknowledgments.

methods.name: returnErrorResponseForLive
methods.description: Tests that a timeout results in a GatewayCommandTimeoutException wrapped in a ThingErrorResponse for 'live' channel acknowledgments.

methods.name: keepCommandHeaders
methods.description: Verifies that command headers are preserved and not altered by the acknowledgment process.

methods.name: discardDuplicateAndUnsolicitedAcknowledgements
methods.description: Ensures duplicate acknowledgments and unsolicited acknowledgments are discarded, only keeping valid ones.

methods.name: resetConnectivityHeadersForLive
methods.description: Checks that reply targets and response expectations are reset for 'live' channel responses.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementAggregatorProps
methods.description: Creates and returns Props for the AcknowledgementAggregatorActor with provided command and test kit context.

methods.name: tellThis
methods.description: Helper function to send results from actor tests to the test kit reference.
